caption: The video showcases a close-up of a white rug laid flat and coated in a wet, soapy foam layer, with a stainless-steel cleaning head on a long angled pole resting on its surface. The head, carrying a white bristle-foam mass along its right edge and a blue label on the side, sweeps steadily from the center-right toward the left edge, its bolted side plate remaining toward the camera while the label stays partly visible. As it drags across the rug, the horizontal foam ridge beside the head is visibly displaced and reshaped, and the white bristle-foam mass is dragged alongside the metal housing. Near the left margin the head continues its pass. In the final frames it remains angled near the left, the blue label still in view, the sweeping motion already underway at the start and still ongoing at the end.
